mentions.name: super-release
mentions.description: A semantic-release alternative written in Rust that supports monorepos while otherwise behaving similarly to semantic-release. It ships with an official GitHub Action and supports pull request previews.
mentions.problem: semantic-release does not officially support monorepos, forcing users onto workarounds or community projects on top of it, and it has performance issues in repos with many tags and branches.
mentions.audience: Developers managing releases in monorepos and companies using semantic-release workarounds.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://github.com/BowlingX/super-release, a semantic-release alternative written in rust - that supports mono-repos (but otherwise behaves similar).
mentions.author: bowlingx
